Subject: Landing zone & mutual action plan for pilot — next steps

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move toward a short pilot. Procurement asked me to send a simple MAP so we can align internal milestones (legal, security, PO). High level: we need the MSA and DPA agreed, an order form signed, and then a PO issued before the pilot start.

Proposed timeline from our side: legal review done by Oct 10, procurement sign-off / PO by Oct 22. Can Redwood confirm any blocking items on your side (SOC2 evidence, DPA language, order form template)?

Anne
Head of Partnerships
BioGrid Therapeutics

Attachment: none

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Anne Sorensen <anne.sorensen@biogrid.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Landing zone & mutual action plan for pilot — next steps

Anne — thanks, this is helpful. I attached a first-draft MAP / landing-zone timeline for the pilot to make dependencies explicit. Key callouts from Redwood:

- Legal: we can provide a redline-ready MSA + standard DPA. If BioGrid has redlines, our legal lead (Karthik) can review within 48–72 hours of receipt.
- Security: SOC 2 report and security questionnaire can be shared immediately; if you need additional evidence (pen test report), that will take a few days to pull.
- Order form: we use a short Order Form + PO workflow. We can generate a DocuSign link once commercial terms (term, seat/usage) are locked.
- Onramp: recommended canary pilot (2 weeks) then scale — requires order form signed and PO for reserved capacity if you want dedicated GPUs.

Proposed mutual action plan (high-level milestones & owners):
1) 10/05 — Redwood sends DPA redline (owner: Redwood legal / Karthik)
2) 10/07 — BioGrid provides initial redlines + SOC2 evidence (owner: BioGrid / Anne)
3) 10/09 — Legal alignment on MSA language (owner: Redwood + BioGrid legal)
4) 10/11 — Order Form terms agreed (commercial) (owner: Ava / BioGrid commercial)
5) 10/14 — Order Form signed (DocuSign) (target)
6) 10/21 — Procurement issues PO / reserved capacity (if applicable)
7) 10/25 — Pilot kickoff (canary)

Please confirm owners and any non-negotiable internal dates at your side. I attached the MAP draft (PDF stub) and a link to our standard Order Form.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Karthik for the DPA redlines.

— Ava
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-draft_v1.pdf (attached)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Landing zone & mutual action plan for pilot — DPA notes

Anne / Ava — looping in a couple of notes from Legal.

1) DPA: we will send an editable DPA with track changes by EOD 10/05. High-level asks we anticipate from customers: subprocessor list, data deletion timeline, and SOC2 references.
2) MSA: there are two optional clauses that sometimes slow customers — liability cap clarifications and export controls. If BioGrid has specific enterprise language, please flag it now; otherwise we can push a clean MSA for signature with a 30-day review window.
3) Suggested path: handle DPA redlines first (faster), then iterate MSA. If necessary we can add an appendix to the Order Form to cover scope-of-use and telemetry.

Attachment: DPA-redlines_2026-10-05.docx (stub)

I’ll be available for a 30-minute call Wed/Thu to go through redlines if that helps.

Karthik
Head of Legal (Commercial Contracts)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Landing zone & mutual action plan for pilot — DPA notes

Thanks Karthik — that approach works for us. A couple notes from procurement/legal at BioGrid:

- Timeline: our internal legal will try to return redlines by 10/08. Procurement needs the final Order Form signed to generate the PO — target PO issuance 10/21 is still our expectation.
- Acceptance criteria for the pilot: 1) 3 sample queries at scale (latency < 300ms p95), 2) embedding similarity baseline within agreed threshold, 3) basic logging/audit trace for requests.
- SOC2: we can share our internal SOC2 sharing rules; we expect Redwood to provide the latest SOC2 Type II and an AOC PDF by 10/07.

I attached the SOC2 evidence bundle we asked Redwood to review — this should help speed security sign-off.

Anne
